ruleReferences.application: Critical Slash has the same English conditional guard as the local Corviknight Accelerate record; apply the shared KO/protection semantics, without activating the older Corviknight card. This is an explicit analogue, not a Golisopod-specific FAQ.

ruleReferences.facts: Attack effects precede damage reactions; KO confirmation follows them. Next-opponent-turn wording excludes Pokemon Checkup. Protection concerns attack damage and effects; ignoring target effects bypasses its damage protection. Attack prohibitions prevent declaration and clear when the affected Pokemon goes to the Bench, evolves/devolves or leaves play.

reviewedSemantics: One root atomic registration per attack, AFTER_ATTACK only, no nested program, conditions or targets beyond SELF; all six arguments exact and required. Existing prevent_effects parser supplies the ProtectionEffect after removing scheduling fields.

Registration captures actual AttackCheckpoint.attacker owner, Pokemon UUID and entry, including the real copier. It places a delayedMarker only; it does not add effective protection or inspect current damage/Prizes.

The marker is placed at the actual AFTER_ATTACK application point before captureDamageReactions. Earlier actions are earlier than this effect; subsequent switch/evolve/devolve/leave immediately invalidate it. Never restore an invalidated marker.

finishAttackCheckpoint transfers the registration to this attack's KnockoutCheckpoint before captureKnockoutReactions can drain, or removes it when no KO exists. No global lastAttack.knockedOut condition.

Final commitKnockoutCheckpoint, after every ON_KNOCKOUT reaction and HP-removal cascade, qualifies iff confirmed intersects attackDamage for an owner unequal to original attacker owner. attackDamage already preserves current-attack damage and same-entry provenance and is cleared by survival/healing/directKO. Prizes/awards never participate.

Qualification consumes the checkpoint registration once and moves a still-valid marker to a server waiting list. Actual guard activation occurs only in beginTurn when currentPlayer differs from original controller, after battlefield.beginTurn and before runTurnStart. Extra own turns neither activate nor consume it.

At activation, check original field entry and same token again; remove marker/queue entry once and call existing BattlefieldState.addProtection with original controller and parsed policy. This completes an already applied conditional effect, so it does not reacquire a new Active, top card or source donor and does not re-run effect-immunity checks.

Initial registration checks preventCardEffect using original ATTACK origin, as ordinary self protection does. Later defensive changes do not retroactively remove an already-applied marker; switch/evolve/devolve do. Active continuous protection uses existing clearing and OPPONENT_TURN_END expiry.

finish removes pending marker state from attack checkpoint, KO checkpoint and waiting list before resetting fields. No-KO and invalid-source branches also consume pending state. Reads never consume RNG; token UUIDs are server bookkeeping and labels/replay avoid hidden card identities.

evidenceLimitations.result: The two Golisopod FAQ pages returned older cards' interactions, not a specific Critical Slash ruling. deferredInteractions.scope: Do not modify prize rules or enable an old Doll. Qualification method accepts only confirmed opponent/current-attack-damage facts; a pure predicate test demonstrates absence of award dependency without claiming real zero-prize runtime support.
